checks.extra_checks: 7 source-layout checks, including next-block unsupported denominator and traditional financial cents.

behavior: Accept complete traditional financial numeral tokens 貳參陸, folding only parse and qualifier/range detection copies; original raw, quote and CP spans remain.
Scope whole-value approximate qualifiers to the matched amount via existing shared edge grammar; inner 多余 remains approximate. Frozen unanchored approximate cannot override a validated exact token.
Frozen exact cannot replace a new exact normalization with a different cents value, preventing 5元貳角陸分 becoming 5元.

Reject unsupported postposed 按 units in whole literals and cropped candidate quotes. Known unsupported units permit bare clause end; other 1-12 Han/1-16 Latin unit names require finite pricing ending and a right clause/unknown boundary.
A comma or decimal point after the matched complete monetary token remains a numeric continuation when followed by digits; ordinary punctuation before duration/prose no longer hides the exact amount.
Read-time historical unsupported values never upgrade; evidence and source state remain immutable in synthetic checks.

Source-only cross-layout assertions run only in combined mode with DATA final source/event/arithmetic overlay. Core mode keeps parser and same-clause integration assertions.

peer_review.role: Nonimplementer static review of DATA implementation, plus actual own combined 172 synthetic execution. No claim of executing peer 162/668 or independent 21.
peer_review.conclusion: No new blocker found in bounded unsupported-unit matching, date-cue copy folding, or explicit-operator/pay-component matching. Source remains downgrade-only; finite matching does not imply arbitrary natural language coverage.

limits: No fullcheck/build/HTTP/model/deep historical chain/CI executed by this author; parent owns final integrated verification.
No business enum expansion, currency conversion or arithmetic evaluation. Unknown unit grammar remains deliberately bounded; arbitrary OCR and prose are not claimed.
No mutation of ROOT/CODE, frozen source, original outputs, labels, corrections or previous evidence; no commit/push.
Two products are locked at recorded hashes; no further syntax expansion planned absent a new actual blocker.
